title: About us
subtitle: Technical problem solvers for manufacturing
intro: De Machinedokters believe in local production and a strong manufacturing industry. Since we started in 2018 we have specialised in optimising production processes, modernising ageing machines and building special-purpose machines for companies in a range of sectors.
quote: "If you can dream it, we can make it run."
story:
At De Machinedokters it is all about making things run better. We are technical problem solvers who improve existing machines and processes with durable modifications. Instead of thick reports or standard solutions, we do practical work that delivers results straight away.

Since 2018 we have been helping factories produce more efficiently and building special-purpose machines. That experience has taught us that many machines do not need replacing. They need the right treatment. We work in the factory, among the people and the machines. That is where we see what is really going on and what can be improved.

De Machinedokters was founded in the Netherlands. We now also help manufacturing companies in Örebro, Värmland and Västmanland counties in Sweden.

Freek moved to Grythyttan in Bergslagen in 2025. From there we are building De Machinedokters in Sweden, so that manufacturers here get the same help as our customers in the Netherlands: a local contact, with the whole team behind him.

values.title: Customer-focused
values.text: We listen, work through the problem with you and deliver solutions that fit what you need. We prefer long-term working relationships.

values.title: Innovative
values.text: We get more out of existing machines, often with solutions nobody expected.

values.title: Reliable
values.text: A deal is a deal. We communicate clearly and deliver quality you can rely on.
